name: SOC 2 (AICPA Trust Services Criteria)
notes: Infrastructure-relevant subset of the Trust Services Criteria (Security, Availability, Confidentiality). Not a substitute for the full TSC or an auditor.

requirements.name: Logical access security
requirements.description: Logical access security software, infrastructure, and architectures restrict access to protected information assets.

requirements.name: User provisioning and deprovisioning
requirements.description: New internal and external users are registered and authorized prior to access; access is removed when no longer required.
infra_signals: IAM managed via IaC (no console users)
SSO/identity federation (IAM Identity Center, Entra ID, Cloud Identity)

requirements.name: External access boundaries
requirements.description: Logical access security measures protect against threats from sources outside the system boundary.
infra_signals: WAF in front of public endpoints
VPN or private endpoints for admin access
DDoS protection (Shield, Front Door, Cloud Armor)

requirements.name: Data in transit and removable media
requirements.description: Transmission, movement, and removal of information is restricted and protected during transmission.
infra_signals: TLS enforced on load balancers and endpoints

requirements.name: Vulnerability and configuration monitoring
requirements.description: Detection and monitoring procedures identify configuration changes and newly discovered vulnerabilities.
infra_signals: Config/Policy service enabled (AWS Config, Azure Policy, Security Command Center)

requirements.name: Anomaly monitoring
requirements.description: System components are monitored for anomalies indicative of malicious acts, natural disasters, and errors.
infra_signals: centralized logging (CloudTrail, Activity Log, Cloud Audit Logs)

requirements.name: Incident evaluation
requirements.description: Security events are evaluated to determine whether they could or have resulted in a failure to meet objectives, and are classified.

requirements.name: Change management
requirements.description: Changes to infrastructure, data, software, and procedures are authorized, designed, developed, tested, approved, and implemented.

requirements.name: Capacity management
requirements.description: Current processing capacity and usage are monitored to enable implementation of additional capacity.

requirements.name: Recovery infrastructure
requirements.description: Environmental protections, backup processes, and recovery infrastructure are authorized, designed, developed, and implemented.

requirements.name: Confidential information identification
requirements.description: Confidential information is identified and maintained to meet the entity's confidentiality objectives.
